description: One-line reads of 2026-11-18 (tests/fixtures/holders/), raw pixels as sent by the X1: in each holder preview of sessions 2-8, the first one-line read of the session, which crosses the holder's leading edge and shows the holder code (docs/protocol.md §13). Kept with the user's agreement of 2026-11-18 (these code lines only; docs/decisions.md). Samples: base64 of little-endian UInt16, R G B interleaved, 'pixels' per line as read. Extracted from the raw data of the capture with cap3.py's RAW offsets; no other image data.
